outcome_definition: NOT MEASURED HERE. These are the numbers Gundry 2008 attributes to Liew 2004, restated. Liew 2004 is closed access (no PMCID); it was not read. value = the printed bound: 0.8 and 1.4 are the two ends of the A::T<->G::C homozygote Tm-difference range, 0.4 is the upper bound for the remaining substitutions, 4 is Liew's symmetric unresolvable fraction, 16 is Gundry's own base-pair-neutral fraction, 84 is 100 - Gundry's stated residual resolvable share. Any package text quoting these must label them 'cited, not verified'.
